description: Add human-readable title to coder sessions for better UX in session list and activity cards

tasks.title: Add title column to coder_session table and repo
tasks.spec: specs/coder-session-title/spec.md#Coder session title stored on creation
tasks.description: Add DB migration v21 to add nullable `title TEXT` column to `coder_session` table. Update `CoderSession`, `CoderSessionRow`, `CreateCoderSessionData`, and `SessionWithIssueInfo` interfaces in `coder-session-repo.ts`. Update `insert()` SQL, `rowToCoderSession()` mapper, and `findAllWithIssueInfo()` query to include `title`.
acceptanceCriteria: Migration v21 adds `title TEXT` column to `coder_session` without errors
`insert()` persists title when provided, stores NULL when omitted

tasks.title: Add title to ACP session options and creation paths
tasks.description: Add `title?: string` to `AcpSessionOptions` and `AcpConnectionOptions` interfaces in `acp-session.ts`. Pass `options.title` to `coderSessionRepo.insert()` in both `runAcpSession` (~line 395) and `createAcpConnection` (~line 818). Include `title` in `coder_session_started` SSE event payloads from both code paths. Add `title` to the event bus type definition.
acceptanceCriteria: `coder_session_started` SSE event includes `title` from both paths

tasks.title: All callers supply session title
tasks.spec: specs/coder-session-title/spec.md#Each caller supplies a descriptive session title
tasks.description: Add `title` to the `runAcpSession` / `createAcpConnection` call options in all 8 callers: RalphExecutor (`${task.id}: ${task.title}`), PlanStageRunner (`Plan stage`), CheckStageRunner (`Check stage`), CodeCompilesCheck (`Auto-fix: compilation errors`), BuildTestCheck (`Auto-fix: test failures`), SkillService (`Skill: ${skill.name}`), ExploreACPService (`Explore: ${issue.title}`), and conflict-resolution (`Conflict resolution`).
tasks.notes: SkillService doesn't pass coderSessionRepo so it doesn't create coder_session rows, but adding title to options is still correct for forward compatibility.

tasks.title: API endpoints return session title
tasks.description: Add `title` field to the response objects in `GET /:number/coder-sessions` (issues.ts) and ensure `GET /api/agent/sessions` (agent.ts) returns `title` via `findAllWithIssueInfo` (already updated in T-001).
acceptanceCriteria: `GET /api/issues/:number/coder-sessions` response includes `title` field on each session
`GET /api/agent/sessions` response includes `title` field on each session

tasks.title: Frontend types and session label with priority fallback
tasks.description: Add `title: string | null` to `CoderSessionItem` in `types.ts`. Update `getSessionLabel()` in `SessionHeader.tsx` to use the priority chain: `session.title` > taskId from `executionId` > stage name > first 24 chars of `taskDescription`. Add `title` to the `coder_session_started` event type in the frontend event types.
acceptanceCriteria: `getSessionLabel` falls back to taskId parsed from executionId (e.g. `build-127-T-004` -> `T-004`)
`getSessionLabel` falls back to capitalized stage name
`getSessionLabel` falls back to first 24 chars of taskDescription

tasks.title: Frontend hooks and activity cards display title
tasks.description: Update `useCoderSessions.ts` to include `title` from SSE `coder_session_started` event when constructing live session objects. Update `useActivityCards.ts` `SessionCard` interface to include `title` and pass it through from SSE events. Update `SessionCard.tsx` `ActiveSessionCard` to display `title` as primary label with fallback to `taskDescription`.
acceptanceCriteria: `useCoderSessions` includes `detail.title` when constructing new CoderSessionItem from SSE event
`SessionCard` interface in `useActivityCards.ts` has `title: string | null` field
`ActiveSessionCard` displays `card.title` as primary label when present
`ActiveSessionCard` falls back to truncated `taskDescription` when title is null
